card.name: Digits and dots inside numeric references
card.fires_on: Responds to a digit, colon, period or space in the middle of a number or citation, just before the next digit is written. Seen in section references like (5.2), Bible verses, years and cell-line names.

modes.label: Section references
modes.description: The dot or digit inside a cross-reference such as Warnings and Precautions (5.2).

modes.label: Years and codes
modes.description: A digit or space inside a year or lab code, before the remaining digits.
